summary: Two-stage matrix processing wrapper. MatrixScaleByW(a2, v3) scales the input matrix a2 into a local 64-float buffer v3; if it returns >= 0, sub_515417(a1, v3) runs a second stage over the scaled result. Returns 0 on full success, otherwise propagates the failing stage's error code.

local_names.a1: scalar parameter consumed by the second processing stage
local_names.v3: 64-float local buffer receiving the W-scaled matrix
local_names.result: error-code accumulator returned by each stage

operations.description: Call MatrixScaleByW(a2, v3) to scale the input matrix by its W component into the 64-float local buffer; the returned code is stored in result.
Guard: only run the second stage when MatrixScaleByW succeeded (result >= 0).
Call sub_515417(a1, v3) as the second processing stage over the W-scaled buffer, storing its returned code in result.
Guard: when the second stage also succeeded (result >= 0), return 0 as overall success.
Return 0 on full success, otherwise return the error code of the failing stage.
